claims: C1 when asked for lyrics of a song not in the public domain, the assistant should decline to provide the full lyrics
C2 in that situation the assistant should instead offer an analysis of the key themes

concepts.name: song_not_public_domain
concepts.gloss: S is a song that is not in the public domain

concepts.name: requested_lyrics
concepts.gloss: the user has asked for the lyrics of song S

concepts.name: provide_full_lyrics
concepts.gloss: the assistant provides the full lyrics of song S

concepts.name: offer_analysis
concepts.gloss: the assistant offers an analysis of the key themes of song S

concepts.name: root_authority
concepts.gloss: R is a rule that carries the root level of instruction authority, the highest level not overridable by system, developer, or user instructions
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's text does not define root authority

asserts.read_back: providing the full lyrics of % is forbidden because % is not in the public domain and its lyrics were requested
offering an analysis of the key themes of % is preferred when % is not in the public domain and its lyrics were requested

closure.reason: the example marks providing full lyrics as BAD and the assistant's refusal as GOOD, so the clause prohibits providing full lyrics for a non-public-domain song
the example only prefers offering an analysis in this situation; it does not prohibit or require anything else about offering analysis
